svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows aggregate weekly commits and line movement, followed by a separately scoped lifetime-token snapshot. Code movement, last five years at weekly grain. Totals: 3,262 commits, 33,034,116 additions, 31,453,795 deletions, and 159 active weeks. The commit axis uses log1p; the signed additions and deletions axis uses symmetric log. Rounded combined Codex lifetime: 52.8B tokens, observed Jul 26, 2026. This is one dated snapshot, not a reconstructed history. It is combined before publication; per-source readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. The approximate conversion is ~$42.0K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.796269 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Five years of code movement, plus one dated lifetime token snapshot
